hash: SHA256 canonical JSON sort_keys=true compact separators UTF-8 allow_nan=false
grid: Independently supplied aware NYSE regular-close session/timestamp rows, checked against existing offline native NYSE calendar; daily schedule complete between supplied endpoints, weekly individual closes. Exact unique ordered raw NAV matching before caller repair. Endpoint scope and grid source authenticity remain external admission; no price-union grid.
anchor: Independent PREFILL/OOS_PREDECESSOR NAV/time/ref before scored rows; labels oos/oos2 always require a nonempty date range with a real immediate prior caller row, exact NAV/time/kind. First/before-first OOS or omitted date range rejects. Full/IS intended PREFILL behavior remains. Anchor is not scored grid row.
NAV: Strict finite positive real nonboolean; zero unsupported retained blocked/null, never dropped.
CAGR: ACT/365.25 exact aware elapsed anchor-to-terminal seconds; no epsilon/session-count substitution.
flows: Explicit hash-bound ZERO_EXTERNAL_FLOW_ONLY with exact anchor-to-terminal scope; terminal <= receipt available_at <= measurement cutoff even for empty or zero-valued events. Earlier absence evidence cannot certify a later scope; no receipt restamping. Nonzero/unsupported/untimed flows reject. Internal dividends/cash interest remain NAV.
RF: ACTUAL_INTERVAL_SIMPLE_RETURN, exact anchor/close intervals and source/hash/available_at; every actual row availability <= its interval end and <= aggregate receipt availability <= measurement cutoff. Receipt need not reach terminal when all actual row availabilities are earlier; no quote/zero/interpolation fallback or restamping.
Sharpe: Separate raw/excess_rf ddof1 daily252 weekly52. Insufficient/zero variance null+reason; derived overflow blocked/null and finite JSON.

outputs.all_exports: All broker research exports suffix .research_v2 before extension, including account snapshots, cost audits and holdings. Weekly research curve/metrics/freshness suffix likewise. Legacy readers reject missing canonical files even after research metadata removal.

authority: RESEARCH_ONLY; hash agreement does not authenticate producer or historical PIT; never official mission, selector, fullrun, Registry, A5, paper/broker state or promotion clearance.

caller_contexts.broker: Explicit full context and optional separate valuation_binding; optional windows maps only is/oos/oos2. No full override/unknown package fields or failed opt-in legacy fallback.
caller_contexts.weekly: Exact main/concentrated keys, each entry requires full and permits only optional valuation_binding; strict declared shapes before either measurement. Unknown/windows/misspelled evidence fields reject.
caller_contexts.valuation_binding: rows {session,timestamp}, canonical hash reference, aware cutoff. Every full caller binding point timestamp <= receipt available_at <= binding cutoff <= each measurement cutoff before any window slice. Actual valuation_time_utc must agree, never overwritten. Early IS cannot consume a later full-scope receipt; no clipping, lowering/restamping or invented clocks.

IO: Reject the actual selected caller input cone and resolved forward/reverse input/cache aliases before cleanup, including weekly freshness and native default cash-rate selection. Opt-in holdings/regime/freshness/shared price readers distinguish genuine FileNotFound from read/stat OSError; access failures reach the research guard, never empty/inferred fallback. Required target and explicitly selected rate/slippage missing/stat/read failures also reach that guard. None/unselected/disabled optional evidence and default legacy absence semantics remain; strict slippage is threaded through the existing constructor without duplicating normalization/cost logic. Invalid weekly package rejection has no actual evaluation date: freshness unknown, blocked/null admission. All refused paths preserve input/foreign bytes and disclose current_publication_complete=false, cleanup_complete=false and known retained/unknown leaves/errors without claiming invalidation. Expected OS errors at every opt-in stage return research_blocked/null; incomplete cleanup discloses uncleared names. Only known disjoint research exports are invalidated. Legacy and programming-error behavior remain. Not atomic publication or hostile-host TOCTOU protection.
resources: Existing32MiB/100000rows/depth14 limits remain. Stable nonsymlink regular context inputs before open, bounded cap+1 read plus identity/size and predecode nesting/token checks; canonical size before whole serialization. Frame admission selects only unique date/NAV/optional observed-clock columns (width2/3), validates consumed cells and cumulative32MiB canonical cell budget before records allocation; unused auxiliary width/values never copied. Python3.12 Windows device/ADS fallback; real POSIX FIFO/symlink tests run only on POSIX.
caller_capital: Generated broker full-window PREFILL equals actual starting capital; generated weekly PREFILL equals native initial unit1.0. Neither caller may relabel a different hash-bound NAV as its initial account.
weekly_limitation: Existing monthly-holding weekly mark proxy is not validated supplied net account NAV or new fee/price/PIT/account evidence. Measure with weekly52 diagnostic labels only; no cost kernel changes.
window_diagnostics: Research trade counts use the same inclusive requested dates as legacy, with full count unchanged. Dynamic execution cost diagnostics retain fixed nav_metrics_v2_research mode on top/windows; genuine E1 failure still redacts and uses DO_NOT_USE.
caller_valuation_binding_provenance: When a supplied binding is admitted, completed research metrics retain valuation_binding_provenance={sha256,ref,cutoff}. sha256 covers the entire original {rows,ref,cutoff} before any window slice, ref preserves identity/hash/availability, and cutoff is supplied unchanged. No binding preserves the existing output shape; a digest certifies neither producer authenticity nor archival body storage.
native_calendar_history: Aware local session date must match each grid point; exact native offline NYSE schedule equality decides the close, including historical 15:00/15:30 weekday and Saturday sessions. No contemporary weekday/hour whitelist or arbitrary historical-hour fallback. Daily completeness, weekly actual-close, order/uniqueness, cutoff and span remain strict.
predecode_node_budget: Before json.loads allocates a tree, scan bounded raw bytes against the same encoded limit MAX_ROWS*20 value/container nodes and MAX_DEPTH. Dictionary keys are byte-charged but not nodes; escaped strings count once, as do numbers/literals and empty containers. Native decoding still rejects invalid JSON, duplicate keys and nonfinite values.
broker_requested_window_admission: Full/IS/OOS/OOS2 form one requested broker admission package. Any blocked member replaces top and every requested sibling with blocked/null label/reason-only measurement, stripping completed dates/intervals/digests/provenance. Finite whitelisted execution/cost audit and execution_status remain separate. Real E1 failure retains DO_NOT_USE redaction.
weekly_empty_admission: An opt-in generated empty weekly portfolio is research_blocked with fixed mode/null metrics/admission=false and closed authority. Independently successful portfolios may retain separately labeled diagnostics; aggregate exports remain withheld. Nonfinite freshness fallback also explicitly blocks aggregate admission. Legacy empty-curve behavior is unchanged.
CLI_context_admission: Explicit CLI opt-in first observes/protects the output generation, then reads the selected context before source discovery or cleanup. CONTEXT_INPUT_IO/CONTEXT_FILE_CHANGED refuse with their precise context_input_reason and retained/incomplete-generation telemetry; structural/resource failures retain their own code. No empty-dict fallback or invalidation of protected/inaccessible bytes. Direct APIs retain explicitly supplied context and do not reload the protection path.
research_finite_diagnostics: All opt-in broker metric diagnostics and both CLI JSON outputs use strict finite serialization. Unavailable diagnostic numbers become explicit null/redaction metadata, never fabricated zero calibration. Nonfinite base cost refuses before order execution; valid cost equations/defaults are unchanged. Completed measurement cannot be repaired to success, and unavailable audits cannot erase a real E1 rejection.
broker_first_selected_prefill: Any admitted broker slice whose first selected caller position is zero requires PREFILL and exact actual starting capital, independently of label or range syntax (including IS upper-only/open/explicit first or earlier bounds). Interior selection retains the existing actual immediate predecessor NAV/time/kind; OOS/OOS2 cannot begin row zero. No caller receipt or clock is restamped.
selected_input_decoder_admission: Strict selected raw CSV UnicodeDecodeError/ParserError/EmptyDataError; JSON UnicodeDecodeError/JSONDecodeError; required native PyArrow Parquet ArrowInvalid and pandas PANDAS_ATTRS Unicode/JSON decode are reader-locally normalized to existing OSError research failure. Only finite whitelisted format/cause/reason is retained, no source messages. Existing OSError errno/type and default/None/disabled/optional absence stay unchanged. No engine change, generic programming/configuration catch or post-read suppression.
selected_input_shape_admission: Strict weekly selected JSON requires an object and consumed audit_checks requires absent/None/dict. Strict selected slippage rejects the demonstrated DateParseError only at exact date-only conversion; valid dates/timestamps/timezones/undated/default normalization and cost formulas stay unchanged. All use existing blocked/null/incomplete cleanup disclosure and retain input/foreign bytes.
selected_parquet_attrs_conversion: Only strict selected raw Parquet TypeError/ValueError at the exact installed PyArrowImpl.read -> NDFrame.__setattr__ -> attrs.fset terminal code-object suffix, paired distinct engine/native DataFrame receivers and actual consumed PANDAS_ATTRS metadata/value assignment, is reader-locally normalized to fixed PARQUET/PandasAttrsShape/SELECTED_INPUT_PARQUET_ATTRS OSError. Inspection is bounded/transient with no second footer/JSON decode or retained frames. Unmatched programming/backend/configuration/post-read errors propagate unchanged. Preserve native successful absent/dict/pair/empty-sequence/empty-string coercions and all default engine/normalization behavior; installed-source identity is not producer/PIT authentication or universal future-version compatibility.
direct_API_path_admission: Direct broker/weekly file-load opt-in selects research namespace AND existing IO guard when supplied context is non-None OR load_measurement_context_from_path is true. A selected None path rejects with CONTEXT_PATH_REQUIRED inside the existing caller MetricError admission before source discovery/cleanup; selected file always overrides supplied object and any failure blocks without object/legacy fallback. False/default flag with supplied object plus protection path never reloads; false/default None context plus path alone preserves legacy. Keep existing signatures and binding, unmatched programmer errors and all reader/math/cost/default semantics.
